title: REPORT.md front matter
description: REPORT.md starts with a YAML block between two lines of three dashes (---), described here, followed by a plain-language Markdown report of what was performed. The model chooses its own disagreement categories, subcategories and numeric severity scale; this describes only their structure.

created_at.description: When the compilation was made (ISO 8601); the same value as createdAt in manifest.json.

model_attribution.description: The same model attribution as in manifest.json, with these names.

provider.description: The lab or company that made the model.

engine.description: Optional: the deterministic program and runtime.

commit.description: Optional: the git commit the program ran at.

method_summary.description: One or two sentences summarizing the method.

disagreement_scale.description: The model's own numeric scale for how much a difference matters to meaning (substantive severity).

max.description: The highest level; must be greater than min.

disagreement_categories.description: The model's categories of mechanical difference (how readings differ, for example substitution or omission).

id.description: A short id with no spaces, for example lexical_substitution.

description.description: What kind of difference this covers.

count.description: How many readings fall in it.

disagreement_subcategories.description: The model's subcategories of substantive severity. Every <note type="severity"> in the TEI names one of these ids in its subtype.

id.description: A short id with no spaces, for example lexical_substitution.

level.description: Its level on disagreement_scale, from min to max.

level_label.description: A short badge, for example Minor (1/5).

local_confidence_effect.description: Its effect on confidence in the local reading.

corpus_authenticity_effect.description: Its effect on the authenticity of the manuscript or corpus overall.

count.description: How many readings fall in it.

authenticity_signal.description: What the observed error patterns imply about authenticity.

evidence_usage.description: How each kind of manuscript evidence was used. Say unknown where it was not documented.

provenance.description: How place of origin was handled.

physical_and_scribal.description: How scribal corrections and physical damage were handled.

textual_agreement.description: How agreement between manuscripts was modeled.

totals.description: The same totals as in manifest.json.
